stem: Select the statement that is correct about the external environment of a business.

options.label: A
options.text: It consists only of factors that the business can directly control, such as its staffing levels and production methods.

options.label: B
options.text: It includes conditions outside a business's direct control, such as interest rates, competition and demographic change.

options.label: C
options.text: It affects every business in exactly the same way, regardless of its customers, costs or finance.

options.label: D
options.text: It can be removed as a source of risk if managers prepare a sufficiently detailed forecast.

option_rationale: A is incorrect because staffing and production methods are internal factors under business control.
B is correct because the external environment includes outside conditions that can influence business decisions and outcomes.
C is incorrect because the effect of an external change depends on a business's particular exposure, such as its customers, costs and borrowing.
D is incorrect because planning can reduce or prepare for some risks, but cannot eliminate external uncertainty.
